## 简体中文

- 新增中英文界面与系统语言匹配。
- 增强 CloudFlare-ImgBed 远程资源操作和每篇文章独立资源目录。
- 提升图片上传切换时的预览稳定性，新增真实 Hexo 主题预览。
- 新增 Plugin API v0.1、权限隔离与插件开发文档。
- 使用 Tauri 签名更新包，展示更新内容和实时下载进度。

## English

- Added Chinese and English interfaces with system-language detection.
- Expanded CloudFlare-ImgBed asset operations and per-article asset folders.
- Stabilized image transitions and added real Hexo theme preview.
- Added Plugin API v0.1 with permission isolation and developer documentation.
- Added signed Tauri updates with release notes and live download progress.
